tests.procedure: Run the real source-bound BoardSpec/build-plan review twice. Mutate source bytes/hashes, identities, field and requirement coverage, dependencies, schema, paths and claimed test/approval states in isolated copies.
tests.acceptance: Deterministic exact-byte reports; fourteen current composite blockers visible; unsafe inputs refused without partial output or source edits; all release authorities remain false.

tests.procedure: Generate the supported LED candidate twice using its retained typed recipe; compare actual native files and replay the retained Orion native export/check evidence. Test unsupported input rejection.
tests.acceptance: Source bytes agree across rebuilds and match the retained example. Native evidence is identified as historical replay. Success does not expand generator scope to the automotive A/C board.

tests.procedure: Review the selected architecture, exact block interfaces, power/fault calculations, GPIO/net/ADC schedule and required manufacturer evidence.
tests.acceptance: Exact product contracts and normal/fault limits are resolved and signed by the appropriate independent engineering authority; source contradictions are closed.

tests.procedure: Use a pinned, registered Orion profile to reopen the functional schematic/PCB, run full ERC/DRC/parity and applicable simulations, then inject omissions, wrong pins/nets, shorts, polarity and rule violations into isolated copies.
tests.acceptance: No unwaived errors, hidden exclusions or ignored severities; each preregistered defect is detected; missing models/evidence block the applicable requirement. Actual raw native reports and source identities retained.

tests.procedure: On an approved assembled unit and current-limited fixture, measure startup, rails, idle/max load, reverse/fault response and required crank restart/hold-up. Switch each sensor independently and measure off-state signal back-power and thermal behaviour.
tests.acceptance: Measured voltages/current/waveforms/temperature and fault response meet exact reviewed limits with instrument uncertainty, assembly identity and calibration recorded.

tests.procedure: Stimulate both exact selected pressure paths at calibrated endpoints and intermediate values; check reference/rail error, open/short/unpowered inputs, ground offset, filtering/settling and actual channel rates.
tests.acceptance: Retain raw ADC/voltage and exact calibration/absolute-reference identity; engineering values and fault quality meet reviewed limits. No generic transfer is substituted.

tests.procedure: Stimulate the selected high-line, low-line and ambient probes across approved temperature points. Measure attachment error/response and open/short/stuck behaviour; check firmware role labels.
tests.acceptance: Actual external readings meet the selected probe/interface/calibration limits. Missing probes remain unavailable, and die-health temperature is never reported as line temperature.

tests.procedure: Run acquisition/logging at selected rates with the exact card/socket and inject power loss, card removal/write errors and storage limits. Inspect recovered logs and version/quality lineage.
tests.acceptance: Bounded logs preserve raw observations, calibration/version/quality and agreed recovery behaviour; startup/write-current and loss budgets satisfy the reviewed limits.

tests.procedure: On the identified board, exercise backup-first USB service, NVS preservation, probationary boot/rollback and restore. Observe radio absence in EMPTY_RECOVERY and TEMPERATURE_BENCH; test any later approved runtime link separately.
tests.acceptance: Unit/flash identity, backup hashes, serial/boot/rollback/restore evidence and radio-profile observations satisfy the approved service contract.

tests.procedure: Cross-fit the exact populated board and connector/harness STEP assembly against the retained shell/cassette; verify the actual boards, screws, holes, cable bends, connector mating travel, USB and card service access.
tests.acceptance: Digital and measured physical clearances/tolerances match the reviewed assembly. A rectangular mounting reference or earlier unused space reservation cannot satisfy this test.

tests.procedure: Export the actual native BOM/CPL/Gerber/drill/PDF/STEP set on Orion. Compare references/DNP, exact part/footprint identity, origin/units/side/rotation and independent CAM geometry; mutate omissions, substitutions and coordinates.
tests.acceptance: The exact reviewed source and complete manufacturing package agree under the selected supplier profile, with independent rotation/pick-point and technical review. Missing checks remain incomplete.

tests.procedure: Review the exact requirement, architecture, schematic, layout, calculation, simulation, export and test hashes through the existing separate engineering/fabrication authority workflow.
tests.acceptance: Approvals come from authorized independent participants and bind exact dependencies. Changed sources invalidate approvals; a plan, family rating or software test is not release authority.

tests.procedure: After installation/service approval, run the application-specific crank/transient, thermal, vibration, ingress/condensation and EMC programme with the actual assembly and fixtures.
tests.acceptance: All applicable numeric limits, uncertainty, assembly/calibration identities and observed failures/results are recorded. No public/transportation/military compliance is inferred from component ratings.
